subject: Film & Cinema
title: Shadows and Film Noir
description: A short lesson to help you apply Shadows and Film Noir.

hook.text: In film noir, shadows aren't just absence of light — they're characters in the story.

buildup.text: Hard lighting creates sharp shadows that split faces, suggesting moral ambiguity.

discovery.text: German Expressionist refugees brought shadow techniques to Hollywood in the 1940s.

twist.text: Noir's visual language is so powerful that modern films still use it — Sin City, Blade Runner.

climax.text: Shadows prove that what you can't see is often more powerful than what you can.

quiz.question: Where did film noir's shadow techniques originate?
options: German Expressionism brought to Hollywood by European refugees
